bugs.reason: Early npm 7 ci incorrectly saves manifest and lock files; the dependency graph is understood and retained. Fixed in 7.0.0-beta.12.
bugs.semanticEvidence: The official fix 24f3a5448 adds save:false to arb.reify(), and the v7.0.0-beta.12 release attributes the change to npm/cli#1811. Historical-Node reproductions of beta.0, beta.5, beta.6 and beta.11 in maintenance/evidence/gap-audit/npm/reproductions preserve every installed dependency version, resolved URL and integrity while reproducing all 60 reviewed output-hash signatures exactly. beta.0–beta.5 also remove private:true from package.json; v1/v3 locks are serialized as v2. These metadata/format writes are the upstream ci bug, not an inability to read the input dependency graph. Independent lock-selection canaries install locked is-number 6.0.0, while the same manifest without a lock selects 7.0.0, proving lock consumption for all three formats and both filenames. Reviews are pinned to individual successful-install observations, not inferred from adjacent releases.

bugs.reason: npm ci fails to reject manifest/lock dependency mismatches; valid lockfile graphs remain semantically compatible. Fixed in 8.4.1.
bugs.semanticEvidence: npm/cli#4363 fixes npm/cli#2701 and #3947 by validating the loaded lock inventory against the ideal install; the official v8.4.1 release identifies the fix. Every reviewed observation exits zero, installs exactly the locked is-number 7.0.0, and leaves all observed files unchanged; only its separate contradictory-manifest control installs 6.0.0 and triggers inconclusive classification. Historical-Node replays reproduce that behavior and 8.4.1 rejects the control. All 105 npm artifacts from 7.0.0-beta.0 through 8.4.0 were integrity-checked and their ci sources load the virtual lock and lack validateLockfile; 8.4.1 adds it. Nine-version lock-selection canaries across v1/v2/v3 and both filenames choose locked 6.0.0 while lockless installs choose 7.0.0. This establishes actual lock consumption independently of the failed enforcement control. Full per-observation checks and source hashes are in maintenance/evidence/gap-audit/npm/review-audit.json; no version-wide exception is applied.
